forecasts.question: Will Iran publicly commit to resuming mediated ceasefire negotiations (a named Iranian official or MFA announces readiness for talks) before EOD 2026-09-06?
forecasts.delta_reason: RESOLVE-NO. Iran made no public commitment to resuming mediated ceasefire negotiations as of EOD Sep 5. FM Araghchi stated Aug 19 Iran 'rejects ceasefire and demands a complete end to the war.' Pezeshkian's Sep 1 SCO conditional MOU offer ('if US returns to MOU commitments, Iran will immediately reciprocate') is a conditional reciprocity offer referencing a lapsed framework — not a public commitment to resuming mediated negotiations per resolution criteria. Iranian strikes continued Sep 2-3 (59 missiles/drones Sep 2; further strikes on Kuwait and UAE Sep 3). VP Vance Sep 4: 'no talks with Tehran until it stops shooting at commercial shipping.' No mediator (Qatar, Oman, Pakistan) claimed any imminent session. Resolution criteria unambiguously unmet. Setting p=0.05 (schema minimum) to reflect near-zero residual for EOD Sep 6.
forecasts.resolution_criteria: YES if, before EOD 2026-09-06, a named Iranian official (FM Araghchi, Supreme National Security Council, or IRNA/Tasnim/Press TV quoting an official) issues a public statement committing to resuming or entering mediated ceasefire negotiations with the United States. A 'readiness for talks' declaration counts; mere written-message relay does NOT count.
forecasts.resolution_source_rule: One TIER1 (Reuters/AP/AFP/Al Jazeera) citing the named Iranian official, OR Iranian state media (IRNA/Tasnim) carrying the official statement.
forecasts.ambiguity_rule: Conditional or preconditioned offers ('will talk if US stops strikes') = AMBIGUOUS-RESOLVE-AS-NO unless the US publicly accepts the condition; a mediator asserting Iran is 'open' without a named Iranian official statement = AMBIGUOUS-RESOLVE-AS-NO.

indicators.name: Araghchi or SNSC public statement committing to talks
Oman or Qatar mediator readout citing named Iranian acceptance

forecasts.question: Will Netanyahu's coalition lose its Knesset majority or dissolve early before 2026-10-27?
forecasts.delta_reason: RESOLVE-NO. Both resolution paths exhausted as of July 17, 2026. Path 1 (Knesset roll-call vote confirming majority loss): no such vote occurred before the July 17 mandatory dissolution; cannot occur in a dissolved Knesset. Path 2 (Netanyahu announces early dissolution, election date moves earlier than Oct 27): the July 17 dissolution was mandatory and natural (first Knesset to complete full 4-year term since 1988), not 'early'; Oct 27 is the legally mandated date and cannot be moved earlier through any standard mechanism before the election. The ambiguity_rule's 'weekly cadence / no intra-week deltas' governs probability updates, not resolution events; both YES paths are permanently exhausted and holding ACTIVE at p=0.15 would misstate the forecast state. Judge ruling: RESOLVE-NO effective 2026-09-05.
forecasts.resolution_criteria: YES if a Knesset roll-call vote confirms coalition loss of majority (61 seats), OR if Netanyahu announces early dissolution and election date moves earlier than 2026-10-27. NO if coalition survives to mandatory election date with 61+ seats intact.
forecasts.resolution_source_rule: Knesset official record + Reuters/Haaretz/Times of Israel. Polling alone does not resolve.
forecasts.ambiguity_rule: If coalition drops below 61 but Netanyahu remains caretaker PM until election: YES. If a single party departs but coalition retains 61+: NO. Reviewed weekly only (Sundays); no intra-week deltas.

indicators.name: Degel HaTorah files formal dissolution motion in Knesset
indicators.expected_effect: Knesset already dissolved naturally Jul 17; this path is closed

forecasts.question: Will a confirmed Iran-US indirect negotiating session (mediated, senior officials, named principals) occur before EOD 2026-09-17?
forecasts.delta_reason: UPDATE 0.15->0.07. Sep 1-5 evidence materially reduces probability of a confirmed Iran-US indirect negotiating session in the next 12 days. (1) VP Vance Sep 4: 'no talks with Tehran until it stops shooting at commercial shipping' — explicit US-side rejection of near-term diplomacy; (2) Iran launched 59 ballistic missiles/drones Sep 2 on US facilities in Jordan, Bahrain, Kuwait, Iraq; further strikes on Kuwait and UAE Sep 3 — active kinetic exchange, the most hostile since early September; (3) Pezeshkian's Sep 1 SCO conditional offer rebuffed within hours by the Sep 1 strike wave and Sep 2 retaliation cycle; (4) Qatar PM and Oman FM visits to Tehran Aug 27 produced no scheduled session; Trump waved off deal idea Sep 2. Qatar and Pakistan relay channels remain open but no session date exists. Retaining small residual (0.07) for possibility of Oman back-channel arrangement outside public OSINT view.
forecasts.resolution_criteria: YES if a TIER1 source reports a face-to-face or formally convened indirect negotiating session (not mere message relay) between named US and Iranian senior officials/envoys, hosted by a named mediator (Oman/Pakistan/Qatar/Switzerland), between 2026-09-03 and 2026-09-17.
forecasts.resolution_source_rule: Two independent TIER1 OR one TIER1 + official mediator readout.
forecasts.ambiguity_rule: Message relay through intermediaries without a convened session = AMBIGUOUS-RESOLVE-AS-NO. Trump assertions of 'semi-negotiating' without Iranian or mediator confirmation of a held session = AMBIGUOUS-RESOLVE-AS-NO.

forecasts.question: Will commercial shipping through the Strait of Hormuz reach >=30 vessels/day (7-day rolling average) before EOD 2026-10-03?
forecasts.delta_reason: UPDATE 0.22->0.08. Sep 3-5 evidence substantially worsens the Hormuz outlook. (1) IRGC Khatam Al Anbiya spokesman Ebrahim Zolfaghari officially confirmed Sep 3 that Iranian forces deployed additional Maham-3 and Maham-7 naval mines along southern transit channels — voiding the Aug 27 CENTCOM 'mine-free' declaration; (2) Two commercial tankers struck mines Sep 2-3 (Iran claims; US disputes characterization but confirmed vessels disabled); (3) AIS-tracked daily transits: 11 (Sep 2), 9 (Sep 3), 4 (Sep 4); 10-day rolling average approximately 13-15 vessels, trending down; (4) To reach >=30 vessels/day 7-day rolling average by Oct 3, traffic must more than double from 10-day average, against active IRGC mining, during ongoing bilateral exchange. No deescalation pathway visible.
forecasts.resolution_criteria: YES if any AIS-based ship-tracking source (IMF PortWatch, Straits.live, MarineTraffic, Lloyd's List Intelligence) records >=30 commercial transits/day as a 7-day rolling average at any point between 2026-09-03 and 2026-10-03.
forecasts.resolution_source_rule: AIS-based tracker + one TIER1 or OSINT confirmation (Bloomberg/Reuters/Lloyd's List).
forecasts.ambiguity_rule: Naval escort vessels and warships do not count toward commercial transit; if trackers diverge by >20%, flag AMBIGUOUS.

P&I war-risk cover reinstated by a named insurer for Hormuz passage

forecasts.question: Will commercial shipping through the Strait of Hormuz reach >=20 vessels/day (7-day rolling average) before EOD 2026-11-30?
forecasts.delta_reason: New 86-day forecast. F4 (>=30 vessels by Oct 3) is near-certain to resolve NO. This lower-threshold question (>=20 vessels/day = ~24% of pre-war normal) with a longer horizon (Nov 30) tracks whether the Hormuz blockade partially lifts on any timeframe that matters to energy markets. Current 10-day average approximately 13-15 vessels, trending down following Sep 3 IRGC mine redeployment confirmation. Reaching 20/day requires either a meaningful de-escalation agreement (Oman/Qatar track) or sustained US naval escort operations that commercial operators trust. The 86-day window captures potential post-Israeli-election (Oct 27) diplomatic dynamics. p=0.20 reflects the deep structural difficulty of restoring traffic under active mining while acknowledging the non-trivial window for a partial deal.
forecasts.resolution_criteria: YES if any AIS-based ship-tracking source (IMF PortWatch, Straits.live, MarineTraffic, Lloyd's List Intelligence) records >=20 commercial transits/day as a 7-day rolling average at any point between 2026-09-05 and 2026-11-30.
forecasts.resolution_source_rule: AIS-based tracker (Straits.live/MarineTraffic/Lloyd's List/IMF PortWatch) + one TIER1 or OSINT confirmation (Bloomberg/Reuters/Lloyd's List).
forecasts.ambiguity_rule: Naval/military vessels excluded from commercial transit count. Convoy operations under naval escort count only if civilian commercial operators conduct them voluntarily. If trackers diverge by >20%, flag AMBIGUOUS.

forecasts.question: Will the US and Iran announce or observe a mutual cessation of offensive military operations (formal ceasefire, informal pause, or announced return to a prior MOU framework) before EOD 2026-11-30, confirmed by at least two TIER1 sources?
forecasts.delta_reason: New 86-day forecast. The June MOU collapsed in July; the Sep 1-3 exchange re-escalated sharply. However, the historical pattern in this conflict shows ceasefire attempts roughly every 6-8 weeks (April 8, June 17). The 86-day horizon captures two such cycles post-escalation, plus the post-Israeli-election window (after Oct 27 Knesset results, a new Israeli government's war stance may change US calculus). Pezeshkian's conditional Sep 1 offer keeps the MOU channel theoretically alive. p=0.25 reflects the non-trivial historical base rate of ceasefire attempts, discounted by the severity of the Sep 1-3 exchange and both sides' explicit near-term rejection of talks.
forecasts.resolution_criteria: YES if a formal ceasefire agreement, announced mutual pause in offensive operations, or announced return to a prior MOU framework is confirmed by >=2 independent TIER1 sources (Reuters/AP/AFP/Al Jazeera/Bloomberg), with both US and Iranian officials publicly acknowledging it, before EOD 2026-11-30.
forecasts.resolution_source_rule: Two independent TIER1 (Reuters/AP/AFP/Al Jazeera/Bloomberg) OR one TIER1 + named official government statement from both sides.
forecasts.ambiguity_rule: Unilateral ceasefire (US stops but Iran does not acknowledge, or vice versa) = AMBIGUOUS-RESOLVE-AS-NO. Conditional offers without formal joint announcement = AMBIGUOUS-RESOLVE-AS-NO. A 24h pause that collapses immediately = AMBIGUOUS.

CENTCOM announces ordered pause in offensive strikes against Iran
